phrase.zh: 知识得以延续，因为有人继续翻页。
phrase.en: Knowledge continues when someone turns the page.

visual.zh: 展开的书页、手和代际般的重叠关系，把知识呈现为持续的传递。画中书页不是某部古籍的影印，表达的是阅读与保存的联系。
visual.en: Open pages and hands suggest knowledge passing between people and generations. These are not facsimiles of an identified manuscript, but a link between reading and preservation.

background.zh: 美国国会图书馆收藏的古登堡圣经印于美因茨，日期为 1455 年，文本为拉丁文武加大译本。这一具体藏品让我们看到印刷如何使长篇文本以物质形式流传；它不意味着书籍或印刷技术此前不存在。
background.en: The Library of Congress dates its Gutenberg Bible to Mainz, 1455, with the Latin Vulgate text. This artifact shows a long text circulating in printed form. It does not imply that books or printing had no earlier history.

sources.label: Library of Congress · The Gutenberg Bible
